content: आयतनम् [आयतन्तेऽत्र, यत् आधारे ल्युट्] .²1 Place, abode, house, resting-place; भूमेर्महदायतनं वृष्णीष्व <ls>Kaṭh. 1. 1. 23</ls>. (<ab>fig.</ab> also); शूलायतनाः <ls>Mu. 7</ls> hangmen; स्नेहस्तदेकायतनं जगाम <ls>Ku. 7. 5</ls> was centred in her; <ls>R. 3. 36</ls>; सर्वाविनयानामेकैकमप्येषामायतनम् <ls>K. 103</ls>; ˚मृगेण <ls n="K.">130</ls> domestic deer; <ls>Chāṇ. 32</ls>; (hence) a receptacle, home, support, seat. .²2 The place of the sacred fire, altar, shed for sacrifices. .²3 A sanctuary, sacred place; as in देवायतनम्, मठायतनम् <ab>&c.</ab> यथाकमविशेषेण सर्वाण्यायतनानि च . दर्शितानि <ls>Mb. 13. 156. 11</ls>; विजने वायतने गिरौ वने वा . <ls>Bu. Ch. 5. 19</ls>. .²4 The site of a house, ground-plot. .²5 A barn; <ls>Y. 2. 154</ls>. .²6 An inner seat (with Buddhists who consider the five senses with {%manas%} as the six Āyatanas). .²7 The cause of disease.
